vetSays.line: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Company makes the road shorter.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. (a natural — good pick) They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Chloe, Rachel, Tom and Amina met them at the door — 4 put down. Chloe, Rachel, Tom, Amina are hurt.
🛡️ Rachel, Nathan and Tom met them at the door — 3 put down. Rachel, Nathan, Tom are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Nathan — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Nathan chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rachel just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Rachel, Nathan, Tom and Wanjiru met them at the door — 4 put down. Rachel, Nathan, Tom, Wanjiru are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rachel just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Rachel, Nathan and Tom met them at the door — 3 put down. Rachel, Nathan, Tom are hurt.
🛡️ Rachel, Nathan, Maree and Stan met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Rachel, Nathan, Maree are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Rachel, Nathan, Amina and Stan met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Rachel, Nathan, Amina are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Nathan Lee, 47 — an HVAC tech. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Dowsing, Phoenix Clause, Feast Engine, Green Thumb, Literally.
🛡️ Liam and Quinn met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Liam, Quinn are hurt.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)

regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a crow that watches too long and blinks too little
